gaps: P0: nothing. P2: nothing usable (#2 Bodenehr, about 1740, copies the Merian view). Second P3/P4 views: none strong enough.
notes: #1: BnF gives only ‘17th century’; the Merian Reval/Narva plate is dated 1638–1652 in different sources (Archontologia Cosmica or the Topographia), hence ‘about 1645’; trimmed to the Reval view (top half). #9: Commons gives 1896, but the LOC record says about 1890–1900, so ‘1890s’; bottom caption strip trimmed. #15 (Gartenlaube 1854) repeats the composition of Kügelgen’s painting #3 (about 1828), and #14 is a 1908 book reproduction of an 1828 painting by Johannes Hau, so neither used. P3 alternative: #3 Kügelgen, 1827–30, distant city across the bay (large, color). P5 alternative: #17 Adolf Purve, 1930s photograph of the skyline from the south (distant, black and white).
